fields.kicker: Buying a wallet for someone who says he needs nothing
fields.hook: Which Ridge wallet: Royal Black, Alpine Navy or Matte Olive? Guess wrong, and exchange it within 99 days of your order.
fields.reason_1: Three finishes: Royal Black, Alpine Navy, Matte Olive.
fields.reason_2: Return it in usable condition within 99 days of your order; once the return is approved, the exchange ships free in the U.S.
fields.reason_3: Skip the engraving: a personalized wallet cannot be returned.
fields.offer_line: Return terms as of 23 October 2026; they can change.
